run_interactive_reader: run the DrQA reader model interactively with a pretrained model and GPU support
process_document_question: process a document and question to extract answer spans with ranked scores
run_reader_with_tokenizer: run the DrQA reader with a specified tokenizer like corenlp for tokenization
run_reader_cpu_only: run the DrQA reader model on CPU only without CUDA acceleration
usage_interactive_help: print the interactive module usage banner showing available commands and signatures
